description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultHttpConfig class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.base.config.http package. It verifies immutability, equality, default values, configuration reading, and toString output of the class.

classes.name: DefaultHttpConfigTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class verifying the behavior of DefaultHttpConfig.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the static httpTestConfig by loading the 'http-test' configuration file.

methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods in DefaultHttpConfig work correctly.
